description: Pay-per-call document conversion, PDF text extraction, headless-browser rendering of a URL or HTML to PNG / JPEG / PDF, a health-probed directory of x402 pay-per-call endpoints, a sudoku generator (solver-verified, technique-graded puzzles as JSON or a print-ready A4/Letter book), a book typesetter (prose manuscript to a KDP-ready interior PDF + editable docx), a crossword generator (verified freeform grid from your clue/answer pairs as JSON or print-ready PDFs), a family tree chart layout engine (descendant / ancestor / hourglass charts from people+families JSON or a GEDCOM file, as verified layout JSON or print-ready poster and tiled PDFs), and a dataset quality audit tool (duplicates, missing values, type consistency, class imbalance, numeric outliers and PII-pattern counts for a CSV/JSON dataset, as JSON or a one-page PDF summary). Payment: x402 (USDC on Base). No signup, no API key. Permanent base URL (Cloudflare Worker edge); also published at /docs-api/endpoint.json.

intents.name: convert_document
intents.description: Convert an office document with LibreOffice: docx/doc/odt/rtf/txt/md/html, xlsx/xls/ods/csv, pptx/ppt/odp to pdf, docx, odt, html, txt, xlsx, ods, csv, pptx, odp or png (first page). Send the file as base64 or a public https URL; returns base64 output JSON.

content_base64.description: File bytes, base64 (max 15 MB); or use url

url.description: Public https URL of the file

intents.name: extract_pdf_text
intents.description: Extract text per page from a digital PDF plus metadata as JSON (no OCR).

content_base64.description: PDF bytes, base64; or use url

url.description: Public https URL of the PDF

intents.name: render_page
intents.description: Render a public URL or raw HTML with headless Chromium to PNG, JPEG or PDF (viewport, full-page, wait options).

url.description: Public https URL to render; or use html

intents.name: search_x402_services
intents.description: Search a live, health-probed directory of x402 pay-per-call endpoints (aggregated from public bazaars, probed by us) as JSON: url, price, network, last-20-probe results.

intents.name: x402_demand_signal
intents.description: Settlement-verified demand for x402 endpoints: confirmed paid calls, distinct payer counts and USD/day per seller address, read from USDC Transfer logs on Base over a 24h window. Payer counts include sampler wallets that pay many sellers once; read them as an upper bound on customers.

intents.name: generate_sudoku
intents.description: Generate 1-20 classic 9x9 sudoku puzzles with a proven-unique solution and a technique-based difficulty grade (easy/medium/hard/expert), deterministic per seed, as JSON.

counts.description: Puzzles per level {easy, medium, hard, expert}, total 1-20

returns.description: puzzles[] with level, givens, techniques, puzzle and solution strings

intents.name: build_sudoku_book
intents.description: Build a print-ready sudoku book (30-60 solver-verified, graded puzzles) with a custom title page: A4 + US Letter PDF, puzzles.json, README, zipped as base64.

name.description: Name on the title page (<=50 chars)

intents.name: layout_crossword
intents.description: Lay out 8-30 clue/answer pairs into one connected, verified freeform crossword and return the grid, slots, standard numbering and Across/Down clue lists as JSON; deterministic per seed.

entries.description: 8-30 {answer, clue} pairs; answers 3-15 letters, clues <=110 chars

seed.description: Optional; same seed + entries = same grid

returns.description: grid, slots[], numbering[], clues{across,down}, rows, cols, crossings

intents.name: build_crossword_pdf
intents.description: The same verified crossword as print-ready PDFs (8x10 frame-ready, A4, US Letter; puzzle page + answer key; classic or elegant typography) zipped with puzzle.json as base64.

returns.description: content_base64 zip, files[], pages, rows, cols, crossings

intents.name: layout_family_tree
intents.description: Lay out a descendant, ancestor or hourglass family tree chart from people+families JSON or a GEDCOM file (3-400 people, 2-10 generations) and return verified layout JSON: person boxes with generation and x/y/w/h, formatted dates, spouse and parent edges.

root.description: Person id to build from (auto if omitted)

people.description: 3-400 {id, name, sex, birth, death}; use with families

gedcom.description: GEDCOM 5.5/5.5.1/7.0 text instead of people/families (<=2M chars)

returns.description: nodes[], edges[], width, height, people, generations, verified

intents.name: build_family_tree_pdf
intents.description: The same verified family tree chart as print-ready PDFs: 24x36 and A3 single-sheet posters plus Letter/A4 overview + readable tiles with crop marks + person index; classic or elegant typography; zipped with chart.json as base64.

sizes.description: Subset of letter, a4, 24x36, a3 (default all)

returns.description: content_base64 zip, files[], pages, people, generations

intents.name: outline_manuscript
intents.description: Detect the chapter structure of a prose manuscript (chapters, words and scene breaks per chapter, unprintable characters, warnings) with the same parser the typesetter uses.

manuscript.description: Whole manuscript as text or markdown (<=1.2M chars)

returns.description: words, chapters[], paragraphs, scene_breaks, missing_glyphs, warnings[]

intents.name: typeset_book_interior
intents.description: Typeset a prose manuscript into a print-ready paperback interior: PDF at a KDP trim size with gutter by page count, mirrored margins, running heads, folios, chapters on right-hand pages, front matter and contents; plus an editable docx twin and a layout report, zipped as base64.

manuscript.description: Whole manuscript as text or markdown (<=1.2M chars)

returns.description: content_base64 zip (interior PDF, docx, LAYOUT-REPORT.md), pages, chapter_starts, warnings

intents.name: audit_dataset
intents.description: Audit a CSV or JSON-array dataset (up to 5 MB, 50,000 rows, 200 columns and 2,000,000 cells) for duplicate rows, missing values, inconsistent column types, class imbalance, numeric outliers and PII-pattern hits (counts only, never matched values), plus a 0-100 quality_score.

data.description: CSV text or a JSON array of flat objects

returns.description: row_count, col_count, columns[], duplicate_row_count, duplicate_row_indexes, pii_flags, quality_score, issues[]

intents.name: audit_dataset_pdf
intents.description: The same dataset quality audit as a compact PDF summary (score, top issues, per-column table, PII-pattern flags) zipped with report.json as base64.

data.description: CSV text or a JSON array of flat objects
